items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1957-04-11
items.q: Jim Umfress was the leader of the band. Willie Umfress's father.

ctx.x: Alright, want me to ask him some questions? Yeah, sure. Alright. The first thing we'll start at the beginning, might as well. Where were you born?

I was born in what's called Reserve Louisiana. Reserve Louisiana? Yeah, Reserve Louisiana. It's about what, about 20, 21 to 22 miles from here. And what date was that? That was May the 15th, 1901. Were any of your family musicals? Oh yeah, everybody's musical, whole musical family. My father was a kind of player. He used to play with the famous Onward band here. I guess you might have read the story away. He also was, he went to New York with the band. I think it was 18, we had a little discussion about that.…
Grandfather, I think. Yeah, that's right. Young Willie. Now, could he read?
